notes.title: SIGame 8.7
notes.content: [olist][*][p]“Question for yourself without risk” has been renamed to “Question for yourself.”[/p][/*][*][p]You can enable or disable “no-risk” mode separately for “Question for yourself,” “Question with button,” and “Question for all.” The previous option “Deduct points for a wrong answer” has been removed. The no-risk mode is marked with a shield symbol in the top left corner of the scoreboard.[/p][/*][*][p]For “Question for yourself,” you can set a score factor (from 1 to 10). The question’s value will be multiplied by this factor. By default, the factor is 2, as before.[/p][/*][*][p]The button for changing the player type (to human or bot) has been moved from the “Tables” tab to the context menu of each table.[/p][/*][*][p]A “How to play” mode has been added to the main menu. It helps newcomers understand how to play; what the game button is; and what types of questions and answers exist. If you have ideas to expand this mode—feel free to share them.[/p][/*][*][p]A new interface for question sources, comments, and authors: comments are displayed on the main screen; authors and sources appear in the chat. Comments in the host’s messages often went unnoticed—this should now be improved. Authors and sources of a question must be displayed to comply with copyright. The old setting that allowed hiding sources has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Support for the Serbian language.[/p][/*][*][p]At the beginning of each round, the host sees the progress of media preloading for each player (in the bottom left corner of each player’s card). The host can estimate when all participants have downloaded the media and won’t have to wait for it to load during questions (for this feature to work, players must also have the new version).[/p][/*][*][p]The final game statistics view has been reworked: it is now displayed on the main screen instead of in the chat sidebar, where it was often overlooked.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to download packs from “Trends.” You can immediately start playing top packs (if the server has a link to them).[/p][/*][*][p]Switched from daily to weekly “Trends” and now showing 9 top packs instead of 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to add or subtract values when editing a player’s score. Often there is a need to add or subtract a given amount from a player’s score. Previously, the host had to calculate this mentally, which took time. The new controls make this task more convenient.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a donation button inside the room.[/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531106/b61772d3b8f046599c8a767e6f39c2e21c0db455.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531106/ddfbc8fafa2a91d09519f4cf6c8c487f39aef5a3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531106/c67c6e4bad7b0a48f15c24a8e7b934814a12ecfe.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531106/16ec9f1c8421b23c387cedb6fa8585098ae11706.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531106/8c5cd37c873021b06095f2c6cf5a8cecaa34160e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531106/a62c4ba7dcbe6b0baa3d5e1d88c2fa071092c357.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531106/f7236547eb26ea7faf3455b1b26c9926e90fffe6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531106/b77570d9699e151fd72e76ecfb6e378f425c4a5d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: SIGame 8.6
notes.content: [p]Hi all![/p][p]SIGame 8.6 update is here![/p][list][*][p]When something can be selected on the game table, table style changes.[/p][/*][*][p]A progress dialog is shown when creating or joining a game.[/p][/*][*][p]Game logging option and a "Download log" button.[/p][/*][*][p]"Answer" and "Pass" buttons are disabled when unavailable.[/p][/*][*][p]Room options view and ability to change them on the fly.[/p][/*][*][p]Content service is selected based on sharding logic rather than randomly.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated design of the "Ready" button.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability to change the font of the game table.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531106/dd3213a593f9691d8e4f581b3fcf25e65fb17eee.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531106/fe899714353fbc5670650ed0896bb07be0910bad.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531106/ac27e6d10c46fb7e466773055ec607827e5d18d7.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531106/f6f3fb176ff2089032e489a659cd7c6bfd3a743a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531106/454fce9e5e2ae1213529f6a28e53ced5697ba7d7.png"][/img][/p]

SIQuester 6.4 released today!

Now you are able to export your packages to Stream Workshop and share your creativity with everybody!

SIQuester can be downloaded here: https://vladimirkhil.com/si/siquester

notes.title: SIGame 8.5
notes.content:
SIGame here! Version 8.5 released!

[list]
[*] Steam Workshop support: Subscribe to Workshop packages, select them inside the game and play!
[*] You can edit your name and sex in profile view
[*] Pause button key binding can be set up in settings
[*] Allow to select background image for game room
[*] Appellation message displayed on main screen (like Pause message)
[*] Lobby Trends have tabs for top packages and latest games
[*] Main menu styling: new background image and About game button
[*] Question for yourself title has been redesigned
[*] Edit table menu allowing to free or delete tables
[/list]

notes.title: SIGame 8.4 released
notes.content:
SIGame 8.4 released with a set of important fixes!
[olist]
[*] All game assets are included in the game - their should be no partially loaded game views anymore
[*] Exit button on Main menu (useful for fullscreen mode)
[*] Key settings for Next, Yes, No and Pass buttons
[*] Redesigned lobby view (also displaying language for each room)
[*] Room language filter
[*] Showman is displayed under their's replicas
[*] All links should open in Steam browser
[*] Random game button moved from main menu to lobby
[/olist]

notes.title: Future updates
notes.content:
Hi all!
According to your reviews, the following updates are planned.
[list]
[*] Replacing Cloudflare DNS with something else so it will not be periodically blocked
[*] Supporting Workshop
[*] Enhancing the UI
[*] Enhancing built-in question answers so the acceptance criteria would be more tolerant
[*] Embedding assets into the game so it will always load with all images and fonts
[*] Fix links opening
[/list]
This updates are planned to be released within 1-2 next months.
